## Direct and Indirect Speech: Introduction

Understand the change of speaker and point of view in reported speech.

### Lesson focus

1. Keep the spirit of the original words when reporting what someone said.
2. Consider the speaker, the listener, the time and the place.

### Practise with the image

Read the full lesson image for the original exercise, notes and any answer key shown. Write your own answers before checking a key. A key labelled for another quiz belongs to that quiz.
